name: daily-task-scheduler
description: TypeScript Node.js app that runs a task every day at the same time

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('config.json', 'dist/config.json', { force: true })" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('README.md', 'dist/README.md', { force: true })" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('package.dist.json', 'dist/package.json', { force: true })" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/app/templates', 'dist/app/templates', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('web', 'dist/web', { recursive: true, force: true })" && cd dist && npm install
scripts.start: cd dist && npm install && npm start
